name: Aki no Sakura no Fantasian
original_name: 秋のさくらのファンタジアン
source:
On the way home from school main character meets a mysterious girl Shizuru and wanders through the imaginary landscape full of cosmos images.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
放学回家的路上，主角遇见了神秘女孩Shizuru，与她漫步于充满波斯菊意象的幻想风景之中。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
